00 · Start here
A growth breakdown for Praktika
Why we made this

You built Praktika because, as OpenAI's January story on you puts it, reading and writing a language fluently is one thing and speaking it with confidence is another. Today 30M+ learners talk out loud with lifelike AI tutors in 13 languages. Praktika 4.0 brought a new design and the first animated tutors, Skye and Tama, in February, and your iPhone app shipped five updates in October alone.

This board is one idea for showing that every week: US and UK learners on TikTok and Reels holding a real conversation with a Praktika tutor on their phone, starting before the holidays and the New Year. It is free, so take whatever is useful.

How to read this board
Use the list on the left, or press P to go frame by frame. On a phone, just scroll.
Creator cards: platform, followers and median views on recent videos.
Please note
Made by hypjam from public information, checked 31 Oct 2026. Nobody at Praktika asked for this, and it is not paid work. The creators named here have not been contacted and have no link to hypjam: they show the kind of people we would cast.
12 creators shortlisted, 4 scripts with 32 hooks, and a plan to put Praktika in front of US and UK learners from Thanksgiving to New Year resolutions.
Four numbers to remember
30M+: learners on Praktika, from your home page
$35.5M: the Series A behind Praktika, led by Blossom Capital (TechCrunch, May 2024)
5.6M: plays on one UK creator's "your sign to stop feeling nervous when speaking with natives"
26 Nov: Thanksgiving, then holiday trips and New Year language goals
Who made this

hypjam is a UGC agency in London. We cast, script, direct and edit creators for consumer startups, and run the best videos as ads.

01 · Why UGC
Why creator videos work
Authenticity
People trust people
Your App Store page says learners stop memorizing and start speaking. A real learner saying a full sentence to a tutor for the first time, nerves and all, is proof.
Show, do not tell
The demo is a conversation
A tutor with a face answers out loud and a gentle correction appears on screen. Ten seconds of that shows more than any feature list.
Objections
Answer "I freeze when I speak" on camera
Learners already post about being scared to speak. A creator practicing with a patient tutor answers it better than any FAQ.
A real moment
The holidays and the New Year
Holiday trips, family dinners and New Year goals give people a reason to start speaking now. Your weekly updates give creators something new to show.
Fuel for ads
Creator videos become your ads
Each creator video doubles as a partnership ad. Eight openings per script means the budget goes where viewers actually stay.
Doesn't feel like an ad
Looks like a normal learning diary
So people watch, save and comment with their own language. It is still labelled as an ad, it just does not interrupt.
02 · What we learned
Where Praktika is today
The product
Praktika is an AI language tutor for real speaking practice: natural conversations with lifelike AI tutors who listen, respond and correct you in real time. 13 languages, 1,000+ lessons, role-plays, a start in your native language, pronunciation and fluency feedback, a soft, balanced or strict tone, and lessons made from your own photos, PDFs and voice notes. On iPhone and Android, plus Praktika for Business.
Just shipped
February: Praktika 4.0, a full redesign with Dark Mode, practice topics built around each learner's goals, and Skye and Tama, the first tutors made with your new generative AI animation. October: five iPhone updates, on the 6th, 13th, 19th, 22nd and 26th. January: OpenAI published how your tutors run as a team of agents that plan, teach and track each learner's progress.
Your numbers
30M+ learners, a 4.8 rating from 1.2M+ ratings and 100K+ five-star reviews, from your home page. 4.7 stars from 167K ratings on the US App Store. A $35.5M Series A led by Blossom Capital, after a seed led by Creator Ventures and Blue Wire Capital (TechCrunch, May 2024).
Already in motion
  • Your TikTok, @praktika.app, has 561K followers and posts almost every day, and its two pinned videos passed 6.7M and 2.4M plays (April 2024).
  • Creators post about Praktika in several languages: Nesly's "Have you heard of this English method?" passed 887K plays (June), and a US creator's Praktika video, marked as an ad, 2.2M (May).
  • Smaller learner posts tagged #praktika travel too: "FaceTime type convos" passed 40.9K plays (October 2025).
What that tells us
The demo works on camera: a tutor with a face talking back is easy to film and easy to believe, and the creators already posting about Praktika show it. What is missing is volume in the US and UK: everyday learners of Spanish, French, Japanese and Korean showing a real conversation every week.
The timing
Thanksgiving is 26 November and Black Friday the day after. December brings holiday trips and family visits, and January is when people promise themselves a new language. Content started now has a month to find what works.

03 · The category
How language learning works on TikTok
AI tutor videos
Talking to a tutor already travels
Learners filming chats with AI tutor apps pass millions of plays: "why is Spanish SO HARD?" did 53.1M (September 2025), and "I didn't know I would cry" 4.3M (19 October), both from US accounts.
Language journeys
Day 1 and learn-with-me series
"This is how to kickstart your language journey" did 7.4M plays from a UK polyglot, "ungatekeeping my method to learn any language by 2026" 447.7K from a 2.9K account, and "Going to be documenting me being consistent with my Korean" 180K this month.
Heritage speakers
The no sabo story
"This was one of my biggest insecurities. I wanted to speak spanish perfectly" did 595.7K plays, "As a no sabo kid, I never thought learning Spanish was important" 251.7K, and a NYC meetup for no sabos to practice Spanish 19.2K this month.
The New Year
Resolutions start in the autumn
"Learn French in 3 months to get a head start on your January New Year's Resolutions" passed 1.2M plays (September), and "Going to lock in this year" 849.6K from a 2K account (February).
Also in play
Learners share ChatGPT prompts for conversation practice, and challenges like 75 Fluent have learners posting daily study updates. Speaking out loud is already a habit in these feeds.
The opening for Praktika
The creators already posting about Praktika mostly speak to people learning English. The next pool is the US and UK: learners of Spanish, French, Japanese and Korean, heritage speakers and travelers, each showing a real conversation with a tutor who has a face.
Sources: public TikTok search results for about 25 language-learning searches and about 75 creator profiles (learners, polyglots, heritage speakers, travelers and language-app accounts), all read 31 Oct 2026.
04 · The objection
"I freeze when I have to speak": the objection to win
Most learners understand more than they can say, and speaking is the scary part. The videos should answer with a demo: a real learner talking out loud, pauses and all, and a patient tutor answering.
What you already promise
  • Natural conversations with lifelike AI tutors who listen, respond and correct you in real time
  • Start in your native language, so beginners never feel lost
  • Practice anytime, judgment-free, with a tutor who is always patient
  • Pick the tone: soft, balanced or strict
The fear already travels
"your sign to stop feeling nervous when speaking with natives" passed 5.6M plays, "I wanted to speak spanish perfectly" 595.7K, and "day 1 trying to force myself to speak japanese except im scared of making mistakes" 52.4K.
Practice first, on camera
Your App Store page puts it simply: practice out loud, get instant feedback, and build the confidence to use the language in real life. That is a shot, not a sentence: a learner, a phone on the counter and a tutor answering.
How we use it
Script A films one real conversation, start to finish. Script C starts in English and ends in Spanish. Script D repeats the same question on Day 1 and Day 30.
Keep it real
Real conversations recorded as they happen in the app, the creator's real level, and the tutor's real replies and corrections on screen.
What creators never say
No "fluent in 30 days". No test scores, job or visa promises. Nothing your own pages do not say Praktika does.
05 · Audience
Who to sell to first
Start here
Adults learning Spanish, French, Japanese or Korean
People who studied a language at school and now want to speak it. Your App Store page says it in one line: stop memorizing and start speaking. Formats A and D.
Start here
Heritage speakers
Americans who understand their family's language but freeze when they speak it, and already call themselves no sabos on TikTok. The holidays are when it matters most. Format C.
Broadest reach
Travelers with a trip booked
Holiday trips and spring travel: role-play the cafe, the hotel desk and directions before landing. Your lessons cover travel, and role-play puts the learner in the scene. Format B.
Next
People practicing English for work
Praktika started with English, and OpenAI's case study names professionals and people building new lives in a new country. Rehearsing interview answers from an uploaded resume is a demo of its own. Format A, in English.
Where we would start
Adults learning Spanish, French, Japanese or Korean first. They already post their study routines, the New Year is their moment, and one real conversation with a tutor is the easiest Praktika demo to believe.
06 · The moment
From Thanksgiving to New Year resolutions
Thanksgiving is 26 November and Black Friday the day after. December brings holiday trips and family visits, and January is when people promise themselves a new language. Videos filmed in November are tested before that rush.
Now to Thanksgiving (26 Nov)
6 to 8 creators film Script A, one real conversation with a tutor, and Script C for heritage speakers before family dinners. The first partnership ads go live on Meta and TikTok.
Black Friday to the holidays
Trip-prep role-plays (Script B) for holiday travel, filmed before and during the trips. Budget moves to the hooks and creators that bring downloads.
The New Year
Day 1 series (Script D) start on 1 January for New Year language goals. The best clips from November and December keep running as ads into January.
What this needs from you
  • A Praktika account for each creator, on the plan the scripts need
  • A tracking link per creator to the App Store, Google Play or praktika.ai
  • Which tutors and voices can appear in paid videos
  • One person on your team who signs off within 48 hours
Why not wait for January?
People set New Year language goals in the last week of December and download on 1 January. Videos filmed in November are tested and cut by then, so the budget backs proven hooks, not first drafts.
07 · The first month
Your first four weeks
Week 1 · 9-15 Nov
Shortlist and formats signed off. Creators get Praktika accounts, a script with 8 hooks, and a week of their own conversations with a tutor before anyone films.
Week 2 · 16-22 Nov
The first videos land and we review each one within 48 hours. Conversation videos get 15 and 30 second ad cuts, and hook testing begins.
Week 3 · 23-29 Nov
Thanksgiving week. Heritage speaker videos go up before dinner on the 26th, and budget follows the openings and creators that bring downloads through Black Friday on the 27th.
Week 4 · 30 Nov-6 Dec
Holiday travel starts. A results call: downloads by creator and by ad, what to keep, and the plan for December trips and New Year goals.
If it is a yes this week
Agreements signed and accounts out by Friday. The first videos go live within 14 days of script sign-off.
08 · Formats
Four formats for Praktika
A · Downloads
One real conversation
A learner props their phone on the counter and talks to a Praktika tutor in Spanish, French or Japanese: the tutor answers, a gentle correction appears, and they say it again. Cut into 15 and 30 second partnership ads.
@languageswithemma on Praktika, 2.2M ↗"FaceTime type convos", 40.9K ↗
B · Downloads
Practice the trip before the trip
A traveler with a flight booked role-plays the cafe, the hotel desk and directions with a tutor, snaps a menu to learn the words, then tries it for real on the trip. Holiday travel editions.
@franglaiswithmaddie on nerves with natives, 5.6M ↗"Yorkshireman learning Episode one", 25.3K ↗
C · Reach
No sabo, before the holidays
A heritage speaker practices with a tutor before Thanksgiving or the holidays, starting in English and ending in Spanish, then asks the comments who else is practicing.
@czech.mexx on being a no sabo, 595.7K ↗NYC no sabo Spanish meetup, 19.2K ↗
D · Reach
Day 1 of my New Year language
A creator starts a language from zero on 1 January with the tutor explaining in English, then posts Day 7 and Day 30 with the same tutor and the same question.
@logan.e.jaynes on 15 minutes a day, 395.7K ↗French before the New Year, 1.2M ↗
In every video
1 A real learner at their real level: no rehearsed perfect lines. 2 Praktika on screen in the first 5 seconds. 3 The tutor answering out loud, with the correction on screen. 4 The language, tutor and feedback exactly as the app shows them. 5 "Ad | Paid partnership with Praktika" on screen plus the platform label.

Takeaway
Language videos travel far past follower counts when a real person speaks on camera, and a tutor answering back is a format viewers already watch. So we would run many everyday learners side by side, testing 8 hooks per script.
Where the market is
AI tutor apps already work with US learners on TikTok, and the creators posting about Praktika prove the format for English learners. US and UK learners of other languages, heritage speakers and travelers are the next pool of faces for Praktika.
10 · Script A
Script A: One real conversation
The brief

Where: TikTok and Instagram Reels, then Meta and TikTok partnership ads to the App Store (15s and 30s cuts)

Length: 35-40s master. 15s cut: shots 1, 2, 4 and 8 (the tutor saying hello, the disclosure, the correction, the call to action).

Goal: iPhone downloads from the App Store

Who films it: A US adult learning Spanish, French, Japanese or Korean at a real beginner or intermediate level, 18+, filmed at home with the phone propped on the counter or a desk, on their own Praktika account. Their real level and their real voice, no rehearsed lines.

8 hooks to test (on screen, then spoken)
  1. I talk to my [Spanish] tutor every morning. Watch.I talk to my Spanish tutor every morning. Watch this.
  2. POV: your language tutor has a face and talks backPOV: your language tutor has a face, and it talks back.
  3. I can read [French]. Saying it out loud is another story.I can read French. Saying it out loud is another story.
  4. Ordering coffee in [Spanish], take twoOkay, ordering coffee in Spanish. Take two.
  5. I set my tutor to strict todayI set my tutor to strict today. Let's see how this goes.
  6. [Day 12] of speaking [Japanese] before work[Day twelve] of speaking Japanese before work. [real day only]
  7. The scariest part of a new language is saying it out loudThe scariest part of a new language is saying it out loud. So I practice here first.
  8. 5 minutes, one conversation, no judgmentFive minutes, one conversation, and nobody judging me.

Rules for this video

The creator's own conversation, recorded as it happened in the app: the tutor's real replies, the real correction and the real feedback screen; never mock up a screen or script the tutor. Why it should convert
A spoken conversation with a tutor who has a face is the clearest Praktika demo there is, and it is easy to believe because the creator is visibly not perfect. The correction moment shows the product working in one shot, and the 15 second cut keeps the whole idea.
11 · Script B
Script B: Practice the trip before the trip
The brief

Where: TikTok and Instagram Reels, then Meta and TikTok partnership ads to the App Store and Google Play (15s and 30s cuts)

Length: 30-35s master. 15s cut: shots 1, 2, 3 and 7.

Goal: Downloads from travelers with a trip booked for the holidays or the new year

Who films it: A US or UK traveler, 18+, with a real trip booked (Mexico, Spain, Japan, Korea, Italy or France), who already films travel. Filmed at home before the trip and, if they are already there, at the real cafe, station or hotel desk. Their own trip only.

8 hooks to test (on screen, then spoken)
  1. My flight to [Tokyo] is in [3] weeks. Practicing now.My flight to Tokyo is in three weeks, so I'm practicing now. [real trip only]
  2. Rehearsing ordering food in [Japanese] before I landRehearsing ordering food in Japanese before I land.
  3. POV: you role-play the hotel check-in before the tripPOV: you role-play the hotel check-in before you even pack.
  4. My tutor is playing a waiter in [Madrid]My tutor is playing a waiter in Madrid right now.
  5. Asking for directions in [Italian], take oneAsking for directions in Italian. Take one.
  6. Trip prep: 5 minutes a day with a tutorMy trip prep is five minutes a day with a tutor.
  7. I want to order in [Korean] without pointing at the menuThis trip, I want to order in Korean without pointing at the menu.
  8. Learn before you land: [Mexico City] editionLearn before you land, Mexico City edition.

13 · Script D
Script D: Day 1 of my New Year language
The brief

Where: TikTok and Instagram Reels, posted as a series (Day 1, Day 7, Day 30), then the best cuts as partnership ads

Length: 25-35s per episode.

Goal: Reach and follows in the New Year window, then downloads from the best episodes

Who films it: A US or UK adult starting a new language on 1 January, or picking one back up, who already posts study routines or a challenge such as 75 Fluent. Filmed on Day 1, Day 7 and Day 30, with the same tutor and the same topic each time.

8 hooks to test (on screen, then spoken)
  1. Day 1 of [Japanese]. I know zero words.Day one of Japanese. I know zero words.
  2. New year, new language. Day 1.New year, new language. This is day one.
  3. Same tutor, same question: Day 1 and Day 30Same tutor, same question. Day one, and day thirty. [real days only]
  4. I'm learning [Korean] in 2027. Come with me.I'm learning Korean in 2027. Come with me.
  5. My first conversation in [Italian], everThis is my first conversation in Italian. Ever.
  6. 5 minutes a day. That's the whole plan.Five minutes a day. That's the whole plan.
  7. Starting from zero, and my tutor speaks English firstStarting from zero, and my tutor speaks English first.
  8. Which language are you learning this year?Which language are you learning this year? Tell me.

TimeWhat we seeOn screenSpoken

Product moment and call to action

On screen at 0:00: the tutor greeting the creator. Named at 0:02. Hero moment 0:05-0:20: the goal, the study plan and a first conversation from zero with the tutor explaining in English. Later episodes repeat the same topic so the change is visible.

CTA: Comment the language you are starting, and follow for Day 7. Partnership ad cuts point to the App Store and Google Play.

Caption
Ad | Paid partnership with @praktika.app. Day 1 of [Japanese] in 2027. [Your real goal, one line.] Follow for Day 7. #ad #praktika #newyearnewme #languagelearning
Rules for this video

FTC: 'Ad | Paid partnership with Praktika' on screen from 0s to the end, a spoken disclosure by 0:05, the platform label switched on (TikTok 'Paid partnership', Instagram and Facebook 'Paid partnership', YouTube 'Includes paid promotion'), and the caption opens with the disclosure. Partnership ads run from the creator's handle with Praktika as the partner. Every day number, streak and stat shown exactly as the app shows it on that day; no re-shot Day 30. The creator's real progress only, with no claims about fluency, test scores or how fast anyone will learn, and nothing your own pages do not say.

Why it should convert
New Year language goals are one of the most posted resolutions, and Day N series keep viewers coming back for the next episode. Repeating the same topic with the same tutor makes progress visible without anyone making a claim.

16 · Ads
How the paid ads would run
1 · Film
Each script is shot once, with 8 different openings.
→
2 · Launch
Each opening runs as its own ad, from the creator's handle as a partnership ad.
→
3 · Read
After a few days we compare cost per download and how many people watch past 3 seconds.
4 · Cut
The weakest openings switch off and the budget moves to the best two.
→
5 · Remix
Winning hooks get new bodies and new creators.
→
6 · Refresh
New creator videos every week, so the ads never go stale.
Where the ads point
The App Store and Google Play, or praktika.ai, with one tracking link per creator, so every download traces back to the video that drove it.
Why partnership ads
Ads that run from a creator's own handle look like that creator's post, not a brand ad. That is the format these videos are built for.
What we would need
Each creator's OK for partnership ads, access to your Meta and TikTok ad accounts (or ad sets we run next to your team's), and a weekly look at downloads and trials.
17 · Process
How a campaign runs, step by step
1 · Brief
You tell us the goal, the audience and what can and can't be said about Praktika.
→
2 · Cast
We shortlist creators by niche, location and median views. You pick.
→
3 · Offer
We send each creator the brief, the dates and the rate.
4 · Sign
A written agreement with every creator, covering usage and disclosure.
→
5 · Scripts
One per format: 8 hooks, a shot list, screens to record and a caption.
→
6 · Film and upload
Creators film on their phones and upload to a private folder only we see.
7 · Review
We check every video within 48 hours. Nothing posts unapproved.
→
8 · Post
On the creator's own account, with the ad disclosure and the paid-partnership label.
→
9 · Pay and report
Creators paid within 7 days of going live. You get a report every Monday.
Where creators talk to us
One hypjam Discord for every creator. Each campaign gets a private channel group for chat, scripts and posted links that only its creators and your team can see.
Accounts and tutors
Each signed creator gets a Praktika account from you on the plan the scripts need, and talks with a tutor on their own for a week before filming. You tell us which tutors and voices can appear in paid videos.
18 · Reporting
What we report, and when
Every video
Views, how many people stay past 3 seconds, average watch time, saves, shares and comments.
Every creator link
A tracking link for each creator, so downloads trace back to the video that drove them.
Every Monday
A short report: every video, the hooks that won, downloads by creator, and what we change next.
Every month
A review call: spend, downloads, cost per result on anything run as an ad, and the plan for next month.
19 · Rules
Rules we never break
Disclosure
"Ad | Paid partnership with Praktika" on screen, said in the first seconds, and the platform's paid-partnership label on. That is what the FTC asks for.
Who films
Adults only (18+). Creators use Praktika themselves before they talk about it.
What gets said
Nothing your own pages do not say Praktika does. No invented numbers. We never pay for a positive opinion, only for the video.
No fluency promises
Creators show their real level and their real progress. No "fluent in 30 days", no test scores, no job or visa claims, and Praktika is described only in its own words.
Only the creator on camera
Family, friends and strangers appear only if they agree, and no children on camera. Nothing private on screen when a creator uploads a photo, a document or a resume.
How we run it
Every video reviewed within 48 hours before it posts. Creators paid within 7 days of going live.
